<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
Sleep mode releases weights/kv_cache/cuda_graph but keeps every
GroupCoordinator's device process group (HCCL communicators) alive, so a
sleeping NPU engine still holds hundreds of MB per rank. This adds a
platform-gated `comm` tag that releases those communication domains and
rebuilds them on wake without restarting the server.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- Add the `comm` memory-occupation tag. It is not part of `GPU_MEMORY_ALL_TYPES`; only platforms that register a comm backend accept it, so non-NPU paths are unchanged.

| --- | --- | --- |

 GPU_MEMORY_ALL_TYPES = [
     GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE,

@@ -251,6 +251,25 @@ def reg_all_to_all_single(
     group._all_to_all_single(output, input)
 
 
+@dataclass
+class _DeviceGroupSnapshot:
+    """Resolved parameters for rebuilding a GroupCoordinator's device_group.
+
+    Snapshotted at the END of ``__init__``, after every constructor
+    transformation, so a rebuild replays final values instead of re-deriving.
+    """
+
+    # Full post-shift subgroup list: new_group must be entered by every world
+    # rank with the same list, in the same order.
+    group_ranks: List[List[int]]
+    backend: str  # resolved torch_distributed_backend (e.g. "hccl")
+    group_name: str  # resolved group_name (defaults to "anonymous")
+    group_desc: str  # f"{group_name}:device"
+    use_local_synchronization: bool  # derived in __init__
+    timeout: Optional[timedelta]  # _MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP_TIMEOUT at init time
+    pg_options: Optional[Any]  # get_torch_distributed_pg_options(group_name)
+
+
 class GroupCoordinator:
     """
     PyTorch ProcessGroup wrapper for a group of processes.
@@ -566,6 +585,25 @@ def __init__(
                 self.cpu_group, 1 << 22, 6
             )
 
+        # Snapshot for sleep-mode comm cleanup; Mooncake and elastic-EP joiner
+        # groups cannot be replayed by the process-level new_group counter.
+        if (
+            "mooncake" in str(torch_distributed_backend)
+            or recovered_rank
+            or rank_offset > 0
+        ):
+            self._device_group_snapshot: Optional[_DeviceGroupSnapshot] = None
+        else:
+            self._device_group_snapshot = _DeviceGroupSnapshot(
+                group_ranks=[list(ranks) for ranks in group_ranks],
+                backend=str(torch_distributed_backend),
+                group_name=group_name,
+                group_desc=f"{group_name}:device",
+                use_local_synchronization=use_local_synchronization,
+                timeout=_MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP_TIMEOUT,
+                pg_options=get_torch_distributed_pg_options(group_name),
+            )
+

             f"ranks={self.ranks} rank={self.rank} local_rank={self.local_rank} use_pynccl={self.use_pynccl} "
@@ -2108,6 +2146,54 @@ def destroy(self):
         if self.mq_broadcaster is not None:
             self.mq_broadcaster = None
 
+    # Device group lifecycle (used by platform sleep-mode comm cleanup).
+
+    @property
+    def can_rebuild_device_group(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether this group carries a replayable device group snapshot."""
+        return self._device_group_snapshot is not None
+
+    @property
+    def rebuild_group_ranks(self) -> Optional[List[List[int]]]:
+        """The full subgroup list a rebuild will replay, or None."""
+        if self._device_group_snapshot is None:
+            return None
+        return self._device_group_snapshot.group_ranks

+"""Platform-supplied executor for a platform's optional sleep-mode comm tag.
+
+Core owns the tag bookkeeping and decides when ``release``/``resume`` run; the
+backend owns how device communication resources are freed and restored. A
+platform opts in by calling ``register_sleep_comm_backend()`` from its own
+initialization path. The helpers at the bottom are optional.
+"""
+
+import logging
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from typing import Any, ClassVar, FrozenSet, List, Optional
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed
+
+from sglang.srt.distributed import parallel_state
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_BACKEND_CLS: Optional[type] = None
+
+
+class SleepCommBackend(ABC):
+    """Release/resume implementation for one platform tag."""
+
+    #: The memory-occupation tag this backend serves.
+    tag: ClassVar[str]
+
+    #: The backend owns graph drop/recapture, so core skips the TMS graph pause.
+    handles_cuda_graph: ClassVar[bool] = False
+
+    #: Tags that must be resumed together, because ``resume`` depends on them.
+    resume_requires: ClassVar[FrozenSet[str]] = frozenset()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def unsupported_reason(cls) -> Optional[str]:
+        """Why this backend cannot serve its tag here, or None when it can."""
+        return None
+
+    def __init__(self, tp_worker, draft_worker):
+        self.tp_worker = tp_worker
+        self.draft_worker = draft_worker
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def release(self) -> None:
+        """Release everything the tag covers. Fully platform-defined."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def resume(self) -> None:
+        """Restore what ``release`` freed. Fully platform-defined."""
+
+
+def register_sleep_comm_backend(backend_cls: type) -> None:
+    """Register the current process's backend (one accelerator per process)."""
+    global _BACKEND_CLS
+    _BACKEND_CLS = backend_cls
+
+
+def get_sleep_comm_backend_class() -> Optional[type]:
+    """Backend class registered by the current process, or None."""
+    return _BACKEND_CLS
+
+
+def enabled_platform_tags() -> tuple:
+    """Tags the current process's registered backend serves."""
+    backend_cls = get_sleep_comm_backend_class()
+    return (backend_cls.tag,) if backend_cls is not None else ()
+
+
+def make_sleep_comm_backend(tp_worker, draft_worker) -> Optional[SleepCommBackend]:
+    backend_cls = get_sleep_comm_backend_class()
+    if backend_cls is None:
+        return None
+    return backend_cls(tp_worker=tp_worker, draft_worker=draft_worker)
+
+
+def iter_rebuildable_groups() -> List[parallel_state.GroupCoordinator]:
+    """Alive GroupCoordinators that can rebuild their device group, by name."""
+    groups = [
+        group
+        for group in parallel_state.get_all_groups()
+        if group.can_rebuild_device_group
+    ]
+    groups.sort(key=lambda group: group.unique_name)
+    return groups
+
+
+def world_cpu_group():
+    return parallel_state.get_world_group().cpu_group
+
+
+def barrier(cpu_group, what: str) -> None:
+    logger.debug(f"[sleep-comm] barrier: {what}")
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+
+
+def group_signatures(groups) -> List[Any]:
+    """(unique_name, group_ranks) pairs; the rank set must match across ranks."""
+    return [
+        (group.unique_name, tuple(tuple(r) for r in group.rebuild_group_ranks))
+        for group in groups
+    ]
+
+
+def assert_ranks_agree(signatures: List[Any], cpu_group) -> None:
+    """Abort before touching anything if ranks disagree on the group set."""
+    gathered: List[Any] = [None] * torch.distributed.get_world_size(cpu_group)
+    torch.distributed.all_gather_object(gathered, signatures, group=cpu_group)
+    if any(other != signatures for other in gathered):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"[sleep-comm] ranks disagree on the comm-cleanup group set: "
+            f"{gathered}. Aborting; no resource has been modified."
+        )
+
+
+def all_ranks_ok(flag: bool, cpu_group) -> bool:
+    """AND-reduce ``flag`` over ``cpu_group`` (MIN on int32)."""
+    tensor = torch.tensor([1 if flag else 0], dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+        tensor, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, group=cpu_group
+    )
+    return tensor.item() != 0

+"""Memory-occupation tag schema shared by the control plane and the scheduler.
+
+A platform adds tags by registering a ``SleepCommBackend``; core then accepts
+that tag and includes it in the tag-less default set. Kept import-light because
+the HTTP-facing process uses it and must not pull in torch.
+"""
+
+import logging
+from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
+
+from sglang.srt.constants import GPU_MEMORY_ALL_TYPES, GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_COMM
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Tags only honored where a platform registered a sleep-comm backend.
+PLATFORM_GATED_TAGS: Tuple[str, ...] = (GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_COMM,)
+
+
+def all_known_tags() -> List[str]:
+    """Every accepted tag, in the default release order."""
+    return list(GPU_MEMORY_ALL_TYPES) + list(PLATFORM_GATED_TAGS)
+
+
+def default_release_tags() -> List[str]:
+    """The tag set a tag-less release means on this platform, in release order."""
+    from sglang.srt.utils.sleep_comm.backend import enabled_platform_tags
+
+    return list(GPU_MEMORY_ALL_TYPES) + list(enabled_platform_tags())
+
+
+def resolve_release_tags(raw_tags: Optional[List[str]]) -> List[str]:
+    """Resolve the effective tag set, dropping platform tags this platform
+    did not register so a cross-platform client can always send the full set."""
+    if raw_tags is None or len(raw_tags) == 0:
+        tags = default_release_tags()
+    else:
+        tags = list(dict.fromkeys(raw_tags))
+
+    from sglang.srt.utils.sleep_comm.backend import enabled_platform_tags
+
+    enabled = set(enabled_platform_tags())
+    for tag in list(tags):
+        if tag in PLATFORM_GATED_TAGS and tag not in enabled:
+            logger.info(
+                "The '%s' memory occupation tag is not supported on this "
+                "platform; ignoring it.",
+                tag,
+            )
+            tags.remove(tag)
+    return tags
+
+
+def validate_tags(tags: List[str]) -> None:
+    unknown = sorted(set(tags) - set(all_known_tags()))
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown memory occupation tag(s): {unknown}")

+"""NPU CI test for sleep-mode comm cleanup with a ViT NPU graph (Qwen3-VL).
+
+With SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH=1 the vision tower's graphs live inside the
+model, outside every model-runner graph. A comm sleep must drop them and their
+class-level pool; the wake recaptures lazily on the next image request.
+
+Usage:
+python3 -m unittest test_sleep_comm_cleanup_vit
+"""
+
+import base64
+import os
+import struct
+import unittest
+import zlib
+
+import requests
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import QWEN3_VL_4B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(
+    est_time=1200,
+    suite="full-2-npu-a3",
+    nightly=True,
+)
+
+if "ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES" not in os.environ:
+    os.environ["ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "0,1"
+
+_MIB = 1 << 20
+FULL_RELEASE_MIN_DELTA_MB = 500
+
+
+def _solid_red_png_b64(width=256, height=256) -> str:
+    """A solid-red RGB PNG built with stdlib only."""
+
+    def chunk(tag, data):
+        body = tag + data
+        return (
+            struct.pack(">I", len(data))
+            + body
+            + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(body) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
+        )
+
+    raw = b"".join(b"\x00" + bytes((200, 30, 30)) * width for _ in range(height))
+    png = (
+        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
+        + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
+        + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw))
+        + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
+    )
+    return base64.b64encode(png).decode()
+
+
+def _device_used_mb():
+    free, total = torch.npu.mem_get_info()
+    return (total - free) / _MIB
+
+
+def _post(base_url, endpoint, payload=None):
+    return requests.post(f"{base_url}{endpoint}", json=payload or {}, timeout=300)
+
+
+def _ask_image_color(test_case, base_url):
+    response = _post(
+        base_url,
+        "/v1/chat/completions",
+        {
+            "model": QWEN3_VL_4B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH,
+            "messages": [
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": [
+                        {
+                            "type": "text",
+                            "text": "What color is this image? Answer with one word.",
+                        },
+                        {
+                            "type": "image_url",
+                            "image_url": {
+                                "url": f"data:image/png;base64,{_solid_red_png_b64()}"
+                            },
+                        },
+                    ],
+                }
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "max_tokens": 16,
+        },
+    )
+    test_case.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+    content = response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    test_case.assertIn("red", content.lower())
+    return content
+
+
+class TestSleepCommCleanupVit(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            QWEN3_VL_4B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=[
+                "--trust-remote-code",
+                "--device",
+                "npu",
+                "--attention-backend",
+                "ascend",
+                "--enable-multimodal",
+                "--tp-size",
+                "2",
+                "--mem-fraction-static",
+                "0.8",
+                "--enable-memory-saver",
+                "--enable-weights-cpu-backup",
+                "--disable-radix-cache",
+            ],
+            # Route ViT execution through ViTNpuGraphRunner.
+            env={"SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH": "1"},
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_1_comm_only_sleep_wake_with_vit_graph(self):
+        # Baseline: captures the ViT graph for this shape.
+        _ask_image_color(self, self.base_url)
+
+        response = _post(
+            self.base_url, "/release_memory_occupation", {"tags": ["comm"]}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+        response = _post(self.base_url, "/resume_memory_occupation", {"tags": ["comm"]})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        # ViT graph lazily recaptured on the rebuilt comms.
+        _ask_image_color(self, self.base_url)
+
+    def test_2_full_sleep_wake_with_vit_graph(self):
+        _ask_image_color(self, self.base_url)
+
+        used_before_mb = _device_used_mb()
+        response = _post(self.base_url, "/release_memory_occupation")
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+        used_released_mb = _device_used_mb()
+        self.assertGreater(
+            used_before_mb - used_released_mb,
+            FULL_RELEASE_MIN_DELTA_MB,
+            f"full sleep should free memory "
+            f"(before={used_before_mb:.0f}MB, after={used_released_mb:.0f}MB)",
+        )
+
+        response = _post(self.base_url, "/resume_memory_occupation")
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+        _ask_image_color(self, self.base_url)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
